Codebook.definition: Quality is understood to be a subjective and complex concept.
inclusion_criteria: Text expressing difficulty in defining or measuring quality as it varies from person to person.
exclusion_criteria: Text that provides objective criteria or measures for quality.
atypical_examples: Very subjective and it depends on who you ask.
Codebook.relevance_to_RQ: Helps understand how practitioners perceive the subjective nature of software quality.

Codebook.definition: Quality involves adherence to business needs and specifications.
inclusion_criteria: Text mentioning software conforming to business needs or requirements.
exclusion_criteria: Text discussing internal code quality or process aspects.
typical_examples: Conformity to business needs and free of defects.
The product confirms to the requirements.
atypical_examples: Software quality is first and foremost the product confirms to the requirements and free of defects.
Codebook.relevance_to_RQ: Addresses how software quality is tied to meeting specified business needs.

Codebook.definition: Quality is ensured by having software free of defects.
inclusion_criteria: Text mentioning software being defect-free as a marker of quality.
exclusion_criteria: Text focusing on internal or code quality without mentioning defects.
typical_examples: Software quality means first and foremost no bugs.
Product quality can be simply defined as being defects free.
atypical_examples: Very broad topic, but I’ll keep it simple. Software quality means first and foremost no bugs.
Codebook.relevance_to_RQ: Highlights defect-free software as a primary measure of quality by scrum practitioners.

Codebook.definition: Quality involves the internal aspects of the software such as code cleanliness and design.
inclusion_criteria: Text discussing the quality of code or design within the software.
exclusion_criteria: Text addressing external product qualities like defect-free status.
typical_examples: Internal quality has to do with the way that the system has been built.
atypical_examples: Clean code is subjective, but we know at least it should be simple, readable and maintainable.
Codebook.relevance_to_RQ: Explores the importance placed on internal attributes such as code quality and software design.

Codebook.definition: Quality is achieved through an effective software development process with continuous improvements.
inclusion_criteria: Text describing the role of development processes in achieving software quality.
exclusion_criteria: Text that mentions product features or defects without describing process significance.
typical_examples: The process is important. Chaos doesn’t deliver software.
We don’t achieve software quality without a process that implements and fosters quality practices.
atypical_examples: Agile is keen on internal quality because we believe in responding to change.
Codebook.relevance_to_RQ: Shows the emphasis scrum practitioners place on process improvement for quality delivery.
